cases.title: Blockbuster récent
cases.notes: A wide theatrical release at a chain multiplex, many venues and showings — the baseline ordinary case.

cases.title: Nouveau Film Indépendant
cases.notes: team_present fires regardless of venue count — confirmed team presence is always worth surfacing.

cases.title: Film de Répertoire
cases.notes: cycle_name fires on its own, independent of the film's age or venue count.

cases.title: Film Patrimonial
cases.notes: institution_venue fires on venue kind alone.

cases.title: Classique Ressorti
cases.notes: repertory_rarity isolated: 16 years old, but venue/showing counts kept above the aggregate-rule thresholds so only the age signal fires.

cases.title: Film d'Auteur Confidentiel
cases.notes: rare_venue_count and sparse_showing_frequency both fire: a recent film shown at only 2 venues, once a week at this one.

cases.title: Sortie Indépendante Modeste
cases.notes: Deliberately at the boundary (one above each aggregate threshold) — a modest but genuinely ordinary independent release should stay unflagged.
